notes.title: 🐺 Prisoners Hunt - "The Pack is Unleashed" 🏹
notes.content:
🔹 NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS
🐺 WOLVES HAVE ARRIVED IN THE GAME!
Wolves are now fully implemented and functional in the game.
Improved AI: Wolves detect players, attack, and patrol the map.
Noise Perception System: They react to gunfire and footsteps.
Smooth Animations: Unique death animations added for wolves.
🎥 INTRO VIDEO SYSTEM
Added a loading screen video system at the game startup.
Fixed an issue where the video would not play correctly.
The video now plays only on first launch and when shaders need to be compiled.
🔄 SPAWN SYSTEM & AI
Manual placement of wolves and hunters for better gameplay balance.
Added a progressive spawn system (currently being improved).
Fixed NPC replication: Wolves and hunters are now fully server-managed.
⚔️ HEALTH & DEATH SYSTEM
Added HP system to BP_WolfPrisonersHunt.
When a wolf reaches 0 HP, it plays a unique death animation.
Used Blackboard to manage behavior for wounded/dead wolves.
🎯 DAMAGE OPTIMIZATION
Improved BP_HitProjectileProp:
Removed unnecessary Break Hit Result for better performance.
Implemented target detection using Tags & Switch on Name.
Differentiated damage types (enemy, object, electricity, etc.).
Fixed a bug where damage was not applied correctly.
🏃 MULTIPLAYER & REPLICATION
Full replication for BP_ChasseurAI and BP_WolfPrisonersHunt.
Adjusted replication settings for optimized NPC synchronization.
Fixed a bug where NPCs were loaded on the client instead of the server.
🔊 NOISE SYSTEM & PERCEPTION
Added Noise Report so AI can detect sound properly.
Adjusted Loudness & Max Range for better NPC sound perception.
Executed event on the server with Multicast to ensure noise transmission to all players.
🗺️ MAP OPTIMIZATION
Fixed PCG generation issues, ensuring proper object updates.
Cleaned DefaultEngine.ini, removing unnecessary references (Linux, Android, etc.).
Adjusted collisions & navigation areas to prevent AI bugs.
🐞 BUG FIXES
✅ Fixed EOS (Epic Online Services) crash, even with the plugin disabled.
✅ Fixed Shader Pipeline Cache not loading properly.
✅ Fixed an issue where shaders wouldn't compile after startup.
✅ Fixed warnings for uncompiled materials during packaging.
✅ Fixed packaging errors, the game now compiles without issues.
✅ Improved sound management to ensure audio is heard at the correct distance.

🛠️ UPCOMING IMPROVEMENTS
🔜 Dynamic spawn system based on player progression.
🔜 Loot system for defeated enemies.
🔜 Dynamic difficulty adjustment system.
🔜 New death animations for hunters.

📌 FINAL NOTE
This update marks a major step forward in optimizing the game and enhancing gameplay. The wolves have finally arrived!
Thank you for your patience and feedback! 💪🔥

🔹 The Prisoners Hunt Development Team 🔹

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix Available – New Sounds and Gameplay Enhancements!
notes.content:
Here’s what’s new in Prisoners Hunt:

notes.title: ⚙️ New Update Available – Prisoners Hunt Keeps Evolving!
notes.content:
Dear players, we’re excited to share a major update that brings essential bug fixes and introduces new mechanics to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new:

Important Fixes
Multiplayer Session Display:

The bug preventing the correct display of the maximum and current number of players on servers has been fixed. You can now view these details accurately when searching for sessions.
Destruction by Chaenombrus:

Chaenombrus can once again destroy objects and obstacles using their weapons. This fix restores the full potential of their abilities.
Fulgeonix Lighting Bug:

The random lighting effect that appeared on Fulgeonix during rain has been resolved. Lighting effects now behave as intended.
New Features and Adjustments
Object Throwing:

Objects thrown at a Fulgeonix now stun them for 5 seconds, in addition to dealing damage. This adds a new layer of strategy to combat.
Fulgeonix decoys are also affected by this mechanic and take damage when hit.
Fire Vulnerability for Fulgeonix:

Fulgeonix now react to fire with a temporary material change, highlighting their vulnerability. This introduces a visual and strategic element for both teams.
Adjustments to Fulgeonix Lightning Power:

Lightning deals less damage to objects compared to standard tools, emphasizing resource management for Fulgeonix players.
Lightning now applies light damage to Chaenombrus, giving Fulgeonix an additional way to fight back while keeping balance in mind.

Why These Changes?
This update focuses on improving the balance between Fulgeonix and Chaenombrus while enhancing immersion and gameplay mechanics. The bug fixes ensure a smoother experience, and the new features provide fresh strategic options for all players.

Thank you for your incredible support of this indie project! Your feedback continues to guide the development, and this is just the beginning of the improvements we have planned for Prisoners Hunt.

Stay tuned for future updates, and keep exploring this world of intense hunting and escape.

🔥 See you in the game, and may the best side win! 🔗

notes.title: 🚀 New Update – Everything Is Clearer in Prisoners Hunt! 🎮
notes.content:
We’ve listened to your feedback and are excited to introduce a new feature to enhance your gaming experience:

Tips Window 💡
A tips window is now accessible at any time:

From the main menu, to prepare before playing.
In-game, by pressing F1, for quick access to the information you need.
What’s in this window?
Character Abilities:

Learn the unique powers of the Chaenombrus and Fulgeonix, along with tips on how to master them.
Detailed explanations of the default inputs for each action.
Environment Mechanics:

Discover how to use tools like axes and pickaxes to break through obstacles.
Learn how to handle situations where tools aren’t enough by using advanced mechanics like duplicating objects or setting up TNT.
Tips for transforming into specific objects and interacting with mechanisms like doors or locked systems.
Game Mechanics:

Understand the nuances of each role and how to maximize your success, whether you’re a Fulgeonix or a Chaenombrus.
Advice on exploring and interacting with the game’s dynamic environments.
Why This Update?
We want to make Prisoners Hunt more accessible while helping you master all the details of the gameplay. Whether you’re a new player or a seasoned one, this tips window will guide you every step of the way.

Thank you again for your incredible support of this indie project! This is just the beginning, and more improvements are on the way. 🔗✨
